programs.description: After spending two sleepless nights taking care of his sick daughter, a person with hearing and speech disability falls asleep in a metro. A passenger photographs him and shares it online.
Struggling to sustain his household through various odd jobs, Sudheendran's life takes a significant turn for the better after he reconnects with his childhood friend, Sathi.
Three inseparable friends devise an ingenious ploy to fund a destitute woman's marriage. However, destiny plays a cruel game after an unscrupulous individual steal their hard-earned funds.
Kalarikkal Achuthankutty and Pattarumatathil Najeeb are best friends and run an event management company. But soon they part ways because Najeeb secretly marries Achuthankutty's sister Athira.
Vinaychandran, a writer, makes a living by selling his average romantic stories. His life takes a turn when he is assumed to be an expert on matters of the heart while trying to help a professor.
Four people, a supermarket employee, a little girl, a housewife and a college student, deal with their everyday problems in life and try their best to overcome them.
Aby, who was abandoned at his wedding, meets a withdrawn woman in need of help. Together, they embark on a healing journey, until his former lover returns and offers a new perspective on his dreams.
Major Mukund Varadarajan, a commissioned officer in the Rajput Regiment of the Indian Army, conducts a counterterrorism operation while being deployed to Jammu and Kashmir.
Arun, a young man, enrols in an engineering college but falls prey to bad habits. As he grows up, he decides to turn over a new leaf and become a responsible adult.
Kurian, a naive man, visits home from London expecting for his nuptials. Later, he learns about his mother's cancer and supports her through the treatment.

Mathukutty, Zachariah and Binoy, whose fathers were friends twenty years ago, return to Goa in order to reclaim a casino. But they face many challenges when a local goon tries to plot against them.
Jimmy gets ensnared in a web of uncertainty when his fiancée goes missing, leaving a suicide note. Later, Kevin assumes the mantle to unravel the enigma.
Hareendran, a software tycoon, runs a successful company with his childhood friend. However, things take an unexpected turn when his friend damages his reputation.
Harikrishnan is an adopted younger brother of Karunan. When Karunan loses his right hand in an accident, Harikrishnan decides to look after his family.
A group of college friends meet after many years for a class reunion. However, due to some unexpected turn of events, several dark secrets are revealed, which changes their lives.
An affluent man is called upon to hand over his vast plot of land to the government. However, situations take a turn when he brings the influential Neyyattinkara Gopan into the picture.
Father Carmen, a priest, joins hands with the police to investigate a series of mysterious suicides. However, he soon stumbles upon a disturbing fact that has serious consequences.
Jayabharathi, an ambitious girl, strives to complete her education. However, when her parents marry her off, she attempts to carve an identity for herself.
Three police officers go on the run after being framed for a crime by corrupt officials. Against the backdrop of dirty politics and bureaucracy, they strive to avoid being arrested.

An advocate disappears after his journalist-wife uncovers a shocking trail of corruption involving a powerful politician. When all hope seems lost, a stranger offers to help the couple secure justice.
Josy is an unemployed young man who never acts responsibly. His life changes when his beloved mother dies in a fatal accident and his long-lost father returns home.
In the small village of Thenkasimangalam, Chako and Gopi's families are cut-throat rivals. Owing to an unexpected turn of events, both the families actively start plotting against each other.
As Venu's dream is to secure an MBBS admission for his daughter, he decides to sell his property to get money for her education. However, his family members try to disrupt his plans.
When Binto learns of his brother Shinto's disappearance, his search for Shinto leads him to collaborate with others, resulting in unforeseen turns, revelations, and memorable experiences.
Mathews owns a farm that is the envy of everyone in the village. It attracts the attention of a dirty land dealer, who entangles him in a vicious bureaucratic web to take it away from him.
Upon arriving in a tribal region, Varghese Peter, a police constable, encounters complications as he discovers the distressing hardships endured by the local communities.
After moving into a hostel in Bangalore for their engineering course, three teenagers get into a terrible brawl with their seniors. To exact revenge, they decide to befriend a gangster.
Ryan Philip is a mischievous 8-year-old who struggles with math and his strict teacher Pappan. However, everything changes when he discovers a magical pen that helps him solve all his problems.

Ajit, an anchor in Kolkata, meets Krishnapriya, who has lost her husband under mysterious circumstances. However, things become complicated when he falls for her while helping to find her spouse.
Siddharth often has problems with his wife Anjali owing to his short temper. Things take an unexpected turn when they get involved with a gangster.
Kunchacko, a millionaire who built his fortune through questionable means, marries Mary and vows to change. However, leaving his past behind proves to be harder than he imagined.
While George's first love disappoints him, Malar, a college lecturer, restores his faith in love. His romantic journey takes him through several stages and helps him find his purpose.

Unni and Ashwathy's life takes a turn after he accidentally kills her cousin in a tussle. After spending time in prison, he moves to Chennai with his family, hoping to start a fresh chapter, but his past catches up with him.
Two close friends, John and Kurian, wish to take their friendship one step further and get their children married. However, they are unaware of the lives their children lead in the city.

Jaison, a teenager, has a crush on Keerthy, but she does not reciprocate his feelings. To make things worse, he gets in trouble with Ravi, the new teacher who is liked by everyone, especially Keerthy.
Four engineering students battle their professor's supernatural schemes to control the campus, encountering cursed gadgets and bizarre scenarios along the way.
Kanan falls in love with Raddhu, the daughter of a ruthless city gangster responsible for numerous deaths. To marry her, Kanan must confront the dangers and challenges that lie ahead.

Sagunan always underestimates his wife and never appreciates her work. However, due to an unexpected turn of events, he ends up realising the value of not only his wife, but women in general.
Friends Chacko and Hari are fed up with their employer and plan a trip to Goa. Their trip turns into something unusual when they discover a mysterious bag.
After facing numerous struggles, Prakashan finally marries his dream girl, Uthara. However, their marriage lasts less than a day, leading to a major clash between their families.
Radha and Sasikumar fall in love with each other. However, her life takes a turn when he refuses to marry her because of his family problems.
A struggling director gets cheated by his friend who steals his script and becomes a famous actor. However, when he finally gets the chance to direct a film, he is forced to cast a dubious actor.
Padmanabhan, a man who joins political rallies to make money, gets into trouble when he is elected mayor of Thiruvananthapuram and is forced to fight corruption in the city.
Krishnan returns home to Kammattippaadam after a call from his friend Ganga. Together, they face their dark past as old crimes resurface, putting their lives in danger.
Madhavan is an honest and hardworking man. However, when a rich man's daughter, Eliana, asks him to abduct her and demand a ransom from her father, his life turns upside down.
Sam Alex, a police officer, resorts to alcohol to ease the pain of his family's death. However, his life turns around when he is called to investigate a series of murders showing a similar pattern.

Brothers Sreedharan and Raman are embroiled in a bitter feud over their ancestral property. In a bid to consolidate all the wealth, Raman hires Sivankutty to woo Sreedharan's daughter.
A wealthy heiress plans to implicate her former boyfriend for her murder by hiring an assassin. Things take a turn when a thief enters the house at the same time.
Widower Murugan moves to Kerala with his three children and irons clothes to make a living. While dealing with daily issues, he also aims to fund the operation of his child who is visually impaired.
In a charming island town, two young lovers, Govutty and Teena, find joy and resilience in each other as they navigate life's trials, discovering the strength that true companionship brings.
Lakshmi, hoping to enter and exit the college hostel unnoticed, offers Bhanuprasad, a student, a sum of money. However, she ends up trapped in the building due to a series of chaotic events.
Ittymaani, who was raised in China, runs a business of counterfeit products in India. However, when he tries to help Annamma who is ignored by her sons, he lands in trouble because she falls ill.
The loyal shadow of two childhood friends, Sokkan, grapples with allegiance and betrayal after a temple's riches come between all of them.
After learning that his father was brutally killed by Bhallaladeva, Mahendra Baahubali raises an army to defeat him and release his mother from the former's captivity.
When Jayanthi's husband, Ramesh, who is accused in a gold smuggling case, goes missing, she comes to Kochi to find him. In her quest to locate him, she comes across Raju, a taxi driver.

Pavithran, a dramatist, goes to a village for inspiration for writing a play. When he comes across Alli, a young woman who is deep in debt, he decides to learn her story for his play.
Aravindan, a Chakyar Koothu artist from a village, gets married to Aswathy, who lives in a city. The whole village decides to accompany him to attend his marriage.
Sadasivan comes across a house where the owner, Kumaran, has committed suicide to protect his wife, Soumini. However, what is even stranger is that a man who is visually challenged is always around.
Worried about their son's future, Eyo's parents arrange his marriage with a divorced millionaire. However, unexpected events follow when he realises he has erectile dysfunction on his wedding night.
Gautham is a young and successful businessman. His life dramatically changes when he meets Nithya, a girl who is suffering from short-term memory loss.

Premachandran, a carpenter, rescues Kanmani, an ill-treated maid, and takes her into his care. However, to escape from her former abusers, Kanmani dresses up as a boy and joins the team of carpenters.
Siddharth and Kalli never seem to be short on money. However, when they meet the women of their dreams, they are pushed into reconsidering their career choices.
When the daughter of a minister gets kidnapped, Christy is called upon to rescue her. Although he manages to save her, he himself gets embroiled in the kidnapper's murder.
Narayanan, who gets convicted for killing his father, returns from prison to his village and works selflessly for its people. However, his vengeful relatives create obstacles for him.

En route to Bangalore, a man falls in love with a beautiful girl. But he soon realises that her father was responsible for the death of his sister during a terrorist attack a long time ago.
Monayi goes to the city to stay with his friend. However, he ends up getting involved in problems which turns chaotic for everyone.
A patriarch of a royal family goes on a mission to find the murderers responsible for killing his descendant. He takes the help of his nephews who are police officers.
Thomas Kutty buys a haunted bungalow and convinces his friends to stay with him on the first night. The trouble begins when they actually see the ghost of the mistress who was killed 70 years ago.
Pulikkattil, an affluent family man, is forced to bear the brunt and burden of his late father's unscrupulous past. Now, Karnan, a jail convict, decides to settle some old scores with him.
Jaison, a young tailor, gains superpowers after being struck by lightning. However, he must thwart the evil intentions of an unexpected adversary to become the superhero that his rural village needs.
Mathimaran, an honest journalist, exposes a fraud by Pazhani, a politician. As a result, it lands his career in trouble, while also threatening his family's safety.
Determined to catch a notorious criminal, a police officer and his team undergoes several challenges as they scale the lengths of the country.
Four misfits navigate societal and parental pressures as they enter adulthood. Subsequently, their heartfelt journey of self-discovery proves that love and acceptance always triumph over judgment.
